_about: Karl Marx (1818-1883) and Friedrich Engels (1820-1895) in English, from Project Gutenberg: Engels's Feuerbach: the roots of the socialist philosophy (1903) and Landmarks of Scientific Socialism, the Anti-Dühring (1907), both translated by Austin Lewis (Chicago: Charles H. Kerr); Revolution and Counter-Revolution, or Germany in 1848, edited by Eleanor Marx Aveling (Kerr, 1912; the articles are Engels's, published under Marx's name, as the edition itself does); and Marx's Secret Diplomatic History of the Eighteenth Century, edited by Eleanor Marx Aveling (Swan Sonnenschein, 1899). The Communist Manifesto and Capital vol. I are on the Adler shelf and are not taken again. US public domain. No uids minted.
